Pinterest reference review

Open the original source and manually save permitted images under originals/ inside this work folder. Set localImage to that relative path. Accept only exactly one visible person with an Instagram-style candid/editorial look: outfit photo dumps, streetwear, mirrors, direct flash, or warm natural light. Reject couples, groups, collages, product-only shots, and formal studio headshots. Confirm sourceURL, creator, rights, setting, pose, instructions, personCount: 1, personConfirmed, styleConfirmed, and approved. AI suggestions and possible source links require review. Remote thumbnails are not loaded by this page.
